members.name: orb_momentum_v29
members.thesis: The opening 15-30 minutes represent overnight information assimilation. A breakout beyond this range indicates a directional institutional order flow imbalance. It exists because large orders cannot be executed all at once and create sustained trends.
entry_long: close > orb_high AND close > vwap AND volume > SMA(volume, 30)
entry_short: close < orb_low AND close < vwap AND volume > SMA(volume, 30)
weaknesses: High frequency of False breakouts (fakeouts)
Difficult to execute near the breakout point due to fast moves
Decays rapidly in low VIX regimes
members.prior_art: Opening Range Breakout (ORB) by Tony Crabel

members.name: opening_range_breakout_v1
members.thesis: This strategy uses the Opening Range Breakout (ORB): it enters when price breaks the high/low of the first 15-minutes of trading【10†L48-L56】. The idea is early volatility (reflecting overnight news and institutional orders) sets a directional bias, so breaking out signals continuation【10†L137-L145】.
members.exit_stop: stop at other side of range (ORL for long, ORH for short)
weaknesses: High risk of false breakouts or breakout failures (whipsaws)
Very sensitive to exact timeframe of opening range (overfitting risk)
Strategy assumes sufficient volatility; may fail on calm days

members.name: opening_range_breakout_v1

entry_long: orb_range > 0.003 * orb_midpoint (range is at least 30 bps — not too tight)
orb_range < 0.5 * atr_20_daily (range is not too wide — room to run)
filters: for long: nifty_50 return from open > 0; for short: < 0

Low win rate (48%) requires discipline; 5-6 consecutive losers are normal
On flat/range-bound days, ORB breakouts fail repeatedly — need regime filter

members.name: orb_15min_v1
members.thesis: The first 15 minutes of the session concentrates institutional order flow from overnight decisions, creating a defined range. Breakout from this range signals directional commitment. The inefficiency exists because retail traders are slow to react to the directional signal embedded in institutional
members.exit_stop: opposite side of ORB (orb_low for longs, orb_high for shorts)
filters: breakout bar volume must be > 1.5x 20-bar avg
prefer longs when nifty50_return_15min > 0, shorts when < 0
weaknesses: False breakouts are frequent — estimated 55-60% of breakouts reverse within 30 bars. Volume confirmation helps but doesn't eliminate the problem.
Gap days with extreme opening ranges (>1.5% width) create poor risk/reward. The stop at the opposite ORB boundary becomes too wide.
Crowded strategy — ORB is one of the most backtested retail strategies in India. Alpha decay is real. The edge is in the filters, not the base concept.
members.prior_art: Classic Opening Range Breakout (Toby Crabel). Widely known. Specific value is in the width filter and volume confirmation.

members.exit_stop: orb_low_15 for longs / orb_high_15 for shorts

members.name: opening_range_breakout_15
members.thesis: Exploits institutional price discovery in the first 15 mins. The high/low of the first 15 mins often acts as a boundary for the day's trend as orders from overnight news are processed. This isn't arbitraged because of the high slippage and volatility at the open.
members.exit_stop: orb_low for long, orb_high for short
weaknesses: False breakouts in choppy opens
Large SL required if ORB range is wide

members.name: first_hour_range_breakout_v1
members.thesis: The first hour (09:15-10:15) establishes a range that captures initial order flow, position adjustments, and reaction to overnight news. Breakouts from this range after 10:15 signal genuine directional commitment that persists into the afternoon. Unlike 15-min ORB, the 1-hour range is more stable an
filters: prefer breakouts in direction of nifty first hour return
weaknesses: Low frequency: 0-1 trades per day. Many days have no breakout, or breakout happens too late for meaningful P&L.
On days when the first hour range is very tight (<0.3%), any breakout is likely noise and the target is too small to cover costs.
Afternoon reversals can erase morning breakout profits — the market has a tendency to mean-revert in the last 90 minutes.
members.prior_art: First hour range breakout. Variant of ORB with longer initial range. See: Toby Crabel, Mark Fisher.
